title: Ecological Systems Theory (Bronfenbrenner)
summary: Bronfenbrenner's ecological systems theory: microsystem, mesosystem, exosystem, macrosystem and chronosystem — nested environmental systems influencing development. Academic enrichment — no direct source coverage in Unit 09 PDFs.
objectives: Identify the five systems and their influence.
revision: Bronfenbrenner's ecological systems theory: five nested systems (micro, meso, exo, macro, chrono). Editorial enrichment — not covered in Unit 09 PDFs.
traps: Bronfenbrenner: 5 nested systems from micro to chrono.

notes.t: Urie Bronfenbrenner proposed that development is influenced by nested environmental systems, from immediate settings to broad culture.
Systems interact bidirectionally — the child influences the environment as well as being influenced by it.
UGC NET may ask about Bronfenbrenner's nested systems and their influence on development.

mnemonics.title: M E M C C
mnemonics.text: M — Microsystem (immediate), E — Mesosystem (connections), M — Exosystem (indirect), C — Macrosystem (culture), C — Chronosystem (time)
